provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Final Girl rulebook (Van Ryder Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose a Killer and a Location from your Feature Films
Pick a Final Girl card; place it faceup below the Player board, Victim Saved spaces showing
steps.note: First games: normal difficulty side of the Player board

steps.text: The 6 Zero Cost Action cards are your starting hand
Other Action cards sorted by name into the two-row Action Tableau
Killer board above the Player board, Location board to its right
1 random Finale card facedown on the Killer board, 1 random Dark Power card facedown below it
Shuffle the Killer's and Location's Terror cards together; deal 10 facedown as the Terror deck
Shuffle the Item cards into 3 facedown piles of 4 above the Location; flip the top card of each
Draw 1 Location Setup card and place the Final Girl, Killer and Victim meeples as it shows; keep it faceup
Mix the 9 black Final Health tokens facedown: 1 unseen on the Killer board, 1 unseen on the Player board, box the rest unseen
Health markers up to each maximum health, counting the black token as one of them
Play turns of five phases until you or the Killer are dead
